claude.sample_unit: notes (25 for summarization task; 1,399 for extraction task)

links.outcome: Summarization accuracy with versus without RAG grounding; hallucination mitigation
links.effect: Zero-shot summaries had 93.25% accuracy; adding RAG gave a 6% increase to 99.25% accuracy. RAG did not further improve accuracy in the risk factor extraction task (about 90%).
links.quote: The addition of RAG improved the summarization process, leading to a 6% increase and achieving an accuracy of 99.25%.

links.outcome: Output accuracy against manually built gold standard dataset
links.effect: Summaries 93.25% accurate overall; risk factor extraction 90% accurate; hallucination when details were not explicitly provided in notes.
links.quote: The model also proved its capability in extracting risk factors with an accuracy of 90%.

unlisted_practices: Zero-shot prompt engineering for EHR summarization and extraction

screen.practice: retrieval augmented generation grounding added to LLM
screen.reason: Evaluates the addition of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to an existing LLM (Llama 2 13B) to mitigate hallucination and improve accuracy in clinical summarization of EHR notes.
